entities.name: Deluge, Northern Wars & Decline
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The devastating Muscovite-Swedish invasion ('The Deluge', 1654–67), the destruction of Vilnius (1655), the Great Northern War, the plague of 1709–11, and the gradual decline of the Commonwealth. The 'silent Sejm' and growing Russian influence.
